items.doc_text: News movies bollywood Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 1: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's Film Mints Rs 64.85 Crore On Opening Day Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 1: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's Film Mints Rs 64.85 Crore On Opening Day Published By : Kashvi Raj Singh , News18.com Last Updated: November 06, 2026, 08:17 IST Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 1: Namit Malhotra-backed project falls short of projected Rs 100 crore India net. Rapid Read Rapid Read Summarized by AI. + Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, grossed Rs 64.85 crore on its India opening, missing high projections despite strong advance sales. The film earned praise for its VFX and Yash's portrayal of Ravana. More Rapid Read Like this summary? Share Your Feedback Got Question about the News? 3 Quick Answers Ramayana Box Office Day 1: Know Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Namit Malhotra's Film's Opening Day Collection Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 1: Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, finally hit theatres yesterday after much anticipation. The pre-release buzz surrounding the film was so intense that many trade experts predicted that it would open to Rs 150 crore. But has the film achieved this feat? Bankrolled by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana Part 1 has grossed Rs 77.50 crore and netted Rs 64.85 crore in India, according to Sacnilk’s latest report. The reported breakdown is: Hindi Rs 47.50 crore, Kannada Rs 7.25 crore, Telugu Rs 6.00 crore, Tamil Rs 2.60 crore and Malayalam Rs 1.50 crore. Recommended Stories The projections were especially high since the advance bookings had crossed Rs 50 crore. As such, many experts believed that the film would open between Rs 100-150 crore. In the North American market, the film has reportedly earned 940,000 dollars, falling just shy of the estimated projection. However, film business expert Girish Johar saw this coming and previously told News18, “It may have a slow start like Dhurandhar. Its business will peak only post-Diwali. As per initial industry reports, the film’s outstanding. But what makes me a little flummoxed is why they’re releasing the film on a Thursday. It’s not a holiday either in India or overseas. I’m predicting Rs 50 crore in India." Ramayana Review Ramayana’s collection is expected to witness a boost after Diwali, and expectations are still quite high. Meanwhile, News18 gave the film 3/5 stars. Our review read, “The film is visually beautiful, and the VFX deserve immense appreciation. The makers have clearly invested heavily in bringing this mythological world to life, and several frames are genuinely breathtaking. The scale and visual treatment make it a cinematic experience worth watching on the big screen." “The biggest surprise package is Yash as Ravana . He takes away the limelight with his powerful screen presence and commanding performance. Strong, fierce and convincing, Yash brings the right intensity to Dashanan. His scenes are among the most entertaining parts of the film, and he delivers exactly the kind of power and impact that audiences would expect from him. Whenever he appears on screen, the film gets a much-needed boost," the review also mentioned. News18 Newsletter Handpicked stories, in your inbox A newsletter with the best of our journalism submit Quick Answers Powered by Ask News18 What was the opening day box office collection for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1 in India? Bankrolled by Namit Malhotra and directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana Part 1 grossed Rs 77.50 crore and netted Rs 64.85 crore in India on its opening day. How did the individual language versions perform on the opening day of Ramayana? The film's net collection breakdown in India included Rs 47.50 crore from the Hindi version, Rs 7.25 crore from Kannada, Rs 6.00 crore from Telugu, Rs 2.60 crore from Tamil, and Rs 1.50 crore from Malayalam. Who stars in Ramayana Part 1, and which actor received special praise for their performance? The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Yash as Ravana. Yash received high praise from reviewers, with critics highlighting his powerful screen presence and commanding performance as Dashanan.
